# Ben Lau's Data Science Portfolio

> > Personal portfolio and knowledge base of Ben Lau, a Hong Kong-based data scientist specializing in Bayesian statistics, marketing analytics, and optimization.

This site features technical notes on machine learning, Bayesian modeling (using PyMC-Marketing), and optimization problems, alongside project demonstrations. Ben Lau is a University of Hong Kong graduate with expertise in customer lifetime value, marketing mix modeling, and probabilistic programming.

## Key Topics

- Bayesian Statistics
- Marketing Data Science
- PyMC-Marketing
- Customer Lifetime Value (CLV)
- Marketing Mix Modeling (MMM)
- OR-Tools Optimization
- Survival Analysis
- Churn Modeling
- Machine Learning
- Predictive Analytics
- BG/NBD Model
- Shifted Beta Geometric Model
- BART Model
- Bayesian GLM
- Decision Trees & Random Forests

## Overview

- [Home](https://benlau6.github.io/): Ben Lau's homepage - data scientist from Hong Kong, UHK grad

## Marketing Data Science

- [Marketing](https://benlau6.github.io/notes/marketing/): Marketing data science guide: CLV, MMM, PyMC-Marketing, survival analysis

## Bayesian Methods

- [Conjugate Priors](https://benlau6.github.io/notes/conjugate-priors/): Bayesian conjugate priors: Beta, Bernoulli, beta-binomial distributions
- [Anomaly Detection](https://benlau6.github.io/notes/anomaly-detection/): Anomaly detection methods: Benford's Law, Bayesian time series, clustering

## Machine Learning

- [Decision Trees](https://benlau6.github.io/notes/decision-trees/): Decision trees tutorial: recursive partitioning, Random Forest, boosting

## Projects

- [Routing Optimization using OR-Tools with Visualization](https://benlau6.github.io/projects/routing-visualization/): VRP solution using OR-Tools constraint programming with time windows
